choose.when: SELECT ID,PARK_ID,RATIO MULTIPLIER,IS_DELETE FROM SMT_ELE_METER WHERE ID=#{meterId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT ID,PARK_ID,1 MULTIPLIER,IS_DELETE FROM SMT_WATER_METER WHERE ID=#{meterId}

choose.when: SELECT * FROM (SELECT ID,COLLECT_TIME,CURRENT_READING FROM SMT_ELE_METER_HISTORY WHERE ELE_METER_ID=#{meterId} AND IS_DELETE=0 AND IS_ERROR=0 AND COLLECT_TIME <= #{boundary} ORDER BY COLLECT_TIME DESC,ID DESC) WHERE ROWNUM=1
choose.otherwise: SELECT * FROM (SELECT ID,COLLECT_TIME,CURRENT_READING FROM SMT_WATER_METER_HISTORY WHERE WATER_METER_ID=#{meterId} AND IS_DELETE=0 AND IS_ERROR=0 AND COLLECT_TIME <= #{boundary} ORDER BY COLLECT_TIME DESC,ID DESC) WHERE ROWNUM=1

mapper.insert: MERGE INTO SMT_ENERGY_METER_DAY_FACT t USING (SELECT #{id} id,#{parkId} park_id,#{meterSource} meter_source,#{meterId} meter_id,#{resourceType} resource_type,#{unit} unit,#{statDate} stat_date,#{dayStartHistoryId} day_start_history_id,#{dayStartTime} day_start_time,#{dayStartReading} day_start_reading,#{dayEndHistoryId} day_end_history_id,#{dayEndTime} day_end_time,#{dayEndReading} day_end_reading,#{multiplierSnapshot} multiplier_snapshot,#{rawDelta} raw_delta,#{usageValue} usage_value,#{qualityCode} quality_code,#{qualityDetail} quality_detail,#{sourceHash} source_hash,#{calculatedAt} calculated_at FROM dual) s ON (t.METER_SOURCE=s.meter_source AND t.METER_ID=s.meter_id AND t.STAT_DATE=s.stat_date) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET RESOURCE_TYPE=s.resource_type,UNIT=s.unit,DAY_START_HISTORY_ID=s.day_start_history_id,DAY_START_TIME=s.day_start_time,DAY_START_READING=s.day_start_reading,DAY_END_HISTORY_ID=s.day_end_history_id,DAY_END_TIME=s.day_end_time,DAY_END_READING=s.day_end_reading,MULTIPLIER_SNAPSHOT=s.multiplier_snapshot,RAW_DELTA=s.raw_delta,USAGE_VALUE=s.usage_value,QUALITY_CODE=s.quality_code,QUALITY_DETAIL=s.quality_detail,SOURCE_HASH=s.source_hash,CALCULATED_AT=s.calculated_at WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ID,PARK_ID,METER_SOURCE,METER_ID,RESOURCE_TYPE,UNIT,STAT_DATE,DAY_START_HISTORY_ID,DAY_START_TIME,DAY_START_READING,DAY_END_HISTORY_ID,DAY_END_TIME,DAY_END_READING,MULTIPLIER_SNAPSHOT,RAW_DELTA,USAGE_VALUE,QUALITY_CODE,QUALITY_DETAIL,SOURCE_HASH,CALCULATED_AT) VALUES(s.id,s.park_id,s.meter_source,s.meter_id,s.resource_type,s.unit,s.stat_date,s.day_start_history_id,s.day_start_time,s.day_start_reading,s.day_end_history_id,s.day_end_time,s.day_end_reading,s.multiplier_snapshot,s.raw_delta,s.usage_value,s.quality_code,s.quality_detail,s.source_hash,s.calculated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT ID FROM SMT_ENERGY_METER_DAY_FACT WHERE METER_SOURCE=#{meterSource} AND METER_ID=#{meterId} AND STAT_DATE=#{statDate}

SELECT ID,PARK_ID,METER_SOURCE,METER_ID,RESOURCE_TYPE,UNIT,STAT_DATE,DAY_START_HISTORY_ID,DAY_START_TIME,DAY_START_READING,DAY_END_HISTORY_ID,DAY_END_TIME,DAY_END_READING,MULTIPLIER_SNAPSHOT,RAW_DELTA,USAGE_VALUE,QUALITY_CODE,QUALITY_DETAIL,SOURCE_HASH,CALCULATED_AT FROM SMT_ENERGY_METER_DAY_FACT WHERE METER_SOURCE=#{meterSource} AND METER_ID=#{meterId} AND STAT_DATE=#{statDate}

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ID,PARK_ID FROM SMT_ELE_METER WHERE IS_DELETE=0 AND PARK_ID IS NOT NULL AND ID > #{afterId} ORDER BY IDSELECT ID,PARK_ID FROM SMT_WATER_METER WHERE IS_DELETE=0 AND PARK_ID IS NOT NULL AND ID > #{afterId} ORDER BY ID) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_ENERGY_METER_DAY_FACT f WHERE f.METER_SOURCE=#{meterSource} AND f.METER_ID=#{meterId} AND f.STAT_DATE=#{statDate}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT_ENERGY_PROJECTION_QUEUE q WHERE q.METER_SOURCE=#{meterSource} AND q.METER_ID=#{meterId} AND q.STAT_DATE=#{statDate} AND q.QUEUE_STATUS IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM DUAL

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SMT_ELE_METER WHERE IS_DELETE=0 AND PARK_ID=#{parkId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SMT_WATER_METER WHERE IS_DELETE=0 AND PARK_ID=#{parkId}
